tagline: One tower against endless waves, and a shop between them that decides how long it stands.
description:
Tower Defense puts a single tower at the centre of the field and sends waves at it from every direction. During a wave the tower fights on its own; between waves the game stops in a shop where you spend the coins you earned on whatever you think the next wave needs, and the shop shows you exactly which enemies are coming before you start it.

You build the tower your way. Three mounts take any of five weapons, from the quick cannon and the flamer that keeps enemies burning to frost that freezes them, a mine layer and a laser that reaches the toughest enemy anywhere on the field. A fire ring and an ice ring guard the edge of your range, and the tower can be repaired, reinforced, given more range, a shield, regeneration, a shockwave, soldiers, drones and tesla pylons. The enemies answer with runners, gunners that shoot from a distance, flyers that pass over mines and ice, armoured knights, splitters, healers and a boss every few waves, from the Warlord and the Colossus to the Wraith, the Hive Queen and the Juggernaut.

Every game also earns points that stay with you. They are spent in a permanent shop, and whatever you buy there every new game starts with, so a tower that fell early today goes further tomorrow. The furthest wave you have reached is remembered and shown next to the current one.

The game is played on its public Game Hub page, full screen in its own tab, on a phone as well as a desktop, and your score lands on the Game Hub leaderboard. The window inside mvmOS is the launcher, and it installs Game Hub for you if it is not there yet. Exit saves the run as it stands and you continue it whenever you come back.
capabilities: A tower at the centre that fights every wave on its own while enemies close in from every side.
A shop between waves that shows what the next wave brings, so every coin is spent with the coming enemies in view.
Five weapons on three mounts: cannon, flamer, frost, mine layer and laser, each with its own upgrades.
Fire and ice rings, plus repair, reinforcement, range, shield, regeneration, shockwave, soldiers, drones and tesla pylons.
Eight kinds of enemies and five bosses: Warlord, Colossus, Wraith, Hive Queen and Juggernaut.
A permanent shop paid with points from every game, so each new game starts stronger, and your best wave remembered.
Save and exit at any point and pick the run back up later.
Runs recorded on your Game Hub profile and leaderboard, played full screen in your own language and theme.

integrations.name: Game Hub
integrations.summary: The game itself runs on its public Game Hub page. Game Hub provides the account you play under, the room the run happens in, and the leaderboard your score lands in.
integrations.requires: Game Hub is required. The launcher window offers to install it if it's missing.
